scope: Runtime assertion checks in pure procedures, built with ASSERTIONS=1 so enforcement is enabled in the cached library. A checksum-guarded manifest edit adds the upstream include directory; library sources and headers are unchanged. The main checks preconditions and postconditions around a pure square-root function. A separate sandbox probe compiles successfully, intentionally calls assert(.false.), and verifies nonzero termination with the expected descriptive diagnostic and unchanged library artifacts, demonstrating that checks were not compiled away. Multi-image/coarray callbacks and every macro variant are not validated. Full current upstream license terms, including its enhancement-contribution provision, are retained under LicenseRef-Berkeley-Assert rather than labeling them as an unmodified standard BSD license.
